title: Scalar coherence and naturality of the prescribed rational tensor associator
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme $W$ on which $\ell$ is invertible at every residue field. Let $E\subseteq L\subset\Omega$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Write $C_F=D^b_c(W,F)$ for the intrinsic raw rational constructible category, whose objects are integral derived-complete constructible objects and whose Hom groups are localized at the coefficient uniformizer [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Use exactly the completed integral tensor and its rationalization $\otimes_F$, the scalar functor $B_{L/E}:C_E\to C_L$, and its prescribed natural tensor comparison $b_{X,Y}:B_{L/E}(X\otimes_EY)\xrightarrow{\sim}B_{L/E}X\otimes_LB_{L/E}Y$ of [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations]. Let $\alpha^F_{X,Y,Z}:(X\otimes_FY)\otimes_FZ\xrightarrow{\sim}X\otimes_F(Y\otimes_FZ)$ be exactly the rational localization of the coherent-reduction-normalized integral associator [def-pod-integral-tensor-constraints]; in Lean this is pullbackTensorRationalAssociator, not an arbitrary chosen associator.

These specified isomorphisms are natural in all three inputs: for $f:X\to X'$, $g:Y\to Y'$, $h:Z\to Z'$ in $C_F$,
$$((f\otimes_Fg)\otimes_Fh);\alpha^F_{X',Y',Z'}=\alpha^F_{X,Y,Z};(f\otimes_F(g\otimes_Fh)).$$
Here semicolons compose from left to right. For $X,Y,Z\in C_E$, put
$$b^{\mathrm l}=b_{X\otimes_EY,Z};(b_{X,Y}\otimes_L1),\qquad b^{\mathrm r}=b_{X,Y\otimes_EZ};(1\otimes_Lb_{Y,Z}).$$
Then the scalar-associator square for these actual maps is
$$B_{L/E}(\alpha^E_{X,Y,Z});b^{\mathrm r}=b^{\mathrm l};\alpha^L_{B_{L/E}X,B_{L/E}Y,B_{L/E}Z}.$$
This includes $E=L$, ramified extensions, and arbitrary constructible inputs; no finite-Tor or scheme finite-type hypothesis is added.

proof.text: Prove naturality by tensor-product induction in each of the three rational arrows. The prescribed bilinear tensor formulas identify the two nested tensor maps on a pure triple a tensor f, b tensor g, c tensor h with the integral nested maps times (ab)c and a(bc). The associator component formula and composition_tmul reduce the equality to integral associator naturality and multiplication associativity. Zero and sum cases follow from bilinearity and preadditivity. This uses the integral naturality declaration directly, avoiding the existing rational naturality node whose DAG statement dependencies reach this item.

For rational objects X,Y,Z, use their unchanged underlying integral objects. The object formulas for rational tensor and scalar extension identify all endpoints with localized integral endpoints. The rational associator component formula, scalar comparison component formula, scalar-extension map formula at coefficient one, and bilinear tensor map formula at coefficients one identify each of the three factors of either composite with the localization of its integral counterpart. Compose these heterogeneous equalities using heq_comp. Functoriality of localization turns both composites into the localization of the integral scalar square. Apply stage3-pur-integral-tensor-associator-scalar-square and combine the equalities. No induction on rational arrows is needed for this second clause, since it only quantifies objects.

(1) Step 1 now instantiates the stage3 limit square: the fixed calculi, Roos models from lem-trf-ambient-comparison-system-existence, the scalar model SY from lem-trf-primitive-quotient-scalar-model-existence (whose Lean takes any calculus SW, so the fixed one is allowed), and TE, TL from tensorModelRealization. For the fixed calculus the transports are identities, so tensorReduction_TE is r^E. The hypothesis IsUnit(l) is equivalent to ℓ being invertible at every residue field. (2) The passage to reductions is now written out: apply R_L, use counit naturality, cancel γ, γ⊗(γ⊗γ) and r, then reflect through faithful reduction. (3) The intertwining node is quantified over SY. It is true, since the counit is invertible on normalized systems. Ramified check with e=2: the indices are the same on both sides. (4) The system associator is pinned to the K-flat associators of lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal. With those, both routes send b⊗((x⊗y)⊗z) to (bx)⊗((1y)⊗(1z)), with no sign. The naturality node is unchanged and needed. The symmetric-calculus node and both existing rational naturality nodes reach the item, so citing any of them would close a cycle. Steps 2-3 (localization and pure-tensor extension) are correct. proof_deps equals the union of the step uses, all ids exist, and there is no cycle.
